question: The Fulfillment-Layer Deep Verification: adversarially verify everything King Maker SEO delivers AFTER a client site ships — the off-page dollar-by-dollar playbook (a real $1k/mo client budget starts spending this week), the cross-client template-fleet footprint risk (the scaling model's biggest unquantified risk), and the GEO/AI-citation evidence base — so the entire delivery stack is evidence-backed end to end.
subQuestions: Which white-hat off-page/authority moves produce MEASURABLE local ranking gains for home-service contractors in 2025-2026, ranked by effort-to-impact with executable workflows: manufacturer certification links (GAF/Owens Corning/Mitsubishi dealer profiles — dofollow status), chamber/community sponsorships, local digital PR, HARO successors (post-Connectively landscape), unlinked-mention reclamation, supplier/association pages, local news coverage, niche directories?

What is the optimal first-$1,000/month off-page spend sequence for a local contractor (month-by-month: foundation → ignition → build), what do legitimate quality links actually COST in 2026 (fair market rates vs link-farm pricing), and which common purchases are documented wastes or penalty risks?

Do white-label platforms running THOUSANDS of templated local-business sites (Scorpion, Hibu, Townsquare Interactive, GoHighLevel agency sites, Thryv, etc.) rank successfully or show documented suppression — and what does their existence at scale prove about Google's tolerance of shared design systems across many client sites?

Which specific footprint signals correlate with multi-site penalties vs safety per documented evidence and practitioner reports: shared IP/hosting, identical HTML/CSS structure, boilerplate content patterns, cross-site linking, shared GA/GSC accounts, identical schema — and therefore what MUST vary per client site when an agency clones one design system across N clients?

What measurably earns citations in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity for LOCAL service queries — studies with effect sizes only: entity/NAP consistency, Bing indexation + GBP data feeds, quotable statistics and answer-first blocks, Reddit/UGC presence, schema, brand mentions — and which popular 'GEO tactics' have NO evidence behind them?

What share of local-service leads/traffic currently arrives via AI assistants and AI Overviews (2025→2026 trend data), and what is the honest ceiling on 'AI visibility' as a sold deliverable for a local contractor today?
checklist: link cost benchmarks 2026 (quality local/niche links, fair market vs spam pricing)
HARO successor landscape post-Connectively (Qwoted, SOS, Featured, etc.)
local digital PR case studies with ranking outcomes
manufacturer certification/dealer profile links: dofollow status + setup workflows
chamber of commerce / sponsorship link value evidence
Scorpion / Hibu / Townsquare / GoHighLevel fleet ranking evidence (do templated fleets rank)
documented multi-site footprint penalties (cases, signals involved)
shared hosting/IP as a penalty signal: evidence status 2026
what must vary per cloned client site (content, structure, hosting, schema, media)
GEO studies with measured effect sizes (Princeton GEO + 2025-2026 successors)
AI Overview citation source analyses for local queries (what gets cited)
AI-assistant referral share of local-service traffic 2025-2026 trend
review platforms beyond Google (Yelp/BBB/Nextdoor) link + citation value 2026
stopCondition: Each off-page lever has cost + impact evidence or is marked evidence-free; the fleet-footprint question has at least 3 independent evidence sources (platform-scale existence proofs or documented penalties); every GEO tactic is marked measured-effect vs no-evidence; conflicts surfaced.
